= REMIX INSTRUCTIONS =
Wanna add your own button? Then follow these instructions!
1. Duplicate "B-0" in the "Button" sprite.
2. Make a new sprite, and a new message called "A-(Button number)". 
3. Add your costumes and sounds.
4. Add what would happen when the button gets pressed and how C1 reacts to it.
5. You can also add things in the thumbnail and more music tracks if you like.
